pr_title: roachprod: fix prom service update issue
pr_body:
When a single node of a cluster is started, the
prometheus config specific to that node is only
updated. This is because we just query information
specific to that node. This change considers all the nodes
in the cluster during cluster start and updates the information
for all the nodes.

 Fixes: #127503
 Epic: None

issue_context.title: roachprod: the prometheus config gets overwritten if a node is started instead of the entire cluster
issue_context.body:
The prometheus config file for a cluster is created at cluster start. But, if we are starting one node at a time, the node specific config is written to the file and any previous config gets overwritten.

Jira issue: CRDB-40456
